name: Reoon Email Verifier
description: Reoon Email Verifier is an email validation service that helps users verify individual or bulk email addresses, identify invalid or risky contacts, and improve email list quality for outreach campaigns.

events.d: Verify a single email address and return validation details; optional mode (quick or full, default quick).
Create a bulk email verification task in Reoon by submitting a list of email addresses.
Retrieve your Reoon Email Verifier account balance.
Retrieve the status, progress, and results of a bulk email verification task using its task ID.
